Produces the manuscript's two supplementary figures: Supplementary Figure 1
(CSIA quality-control/mass-balance checks) and Supplementary Figure 2 (PCA on
normalised and non-normalised amino acid values). See Figures_2_3_4_5_6.Rmd
for the main manuscript figures.

#1. Load packages and colour palette

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(Hmisc)
library(ggpubr)
library(googlesheets4)
library(here)
source(here('script','colors.R'))
```

#2. Load data

```{r}
Data  <- read.csv(here('data','Dataset_S1.csv'), fileEncoding = "macintosh")
Data  <- Data %>% filter(!is.na(Sample_ID))  # drop trailing blank rows
```

#3. Supplementary Figure 1 - CSIA quality control

QC check the CSIA data by plotting Pro against Hyp for each isotope, and check
quality control through estimated mass balance against observed bulk values.

```{r}
S1A <- ggplot(data=Data, aes(y=hyp_d15N, x=pro_d15N))+
  labs(x=expression(delta^{15}*N[Pro]*"(‰)"), y=expression(delta^{15}*N[Hyp]*"(‰)"))+
  scale_x_continuous(position="bottom", limits=c(5,25))+
  scale_y_continuous(position = "left",limits=c(5,25))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=hyp_d15N-hyp_d15Nstdev, ymax=hyp_d15N+hyp_d15Nstdev), linewidth = 0.2, width=0.2)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=pro_d15N-pro_d15Nstdev, xmax=pro_d15N+pro_d15Nstdev), linewidth = 0.2, width=0.2)+
  geom_point(colour="black", fill= ref_cols[["phytoplankton"]], alpha=0.5, pch=21, size=2)+
  geom_abline(intercept=c(0), slope= 1, linetype="solid")+
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
S1A
```

```{r}
S1B <- ggplot(data=Data, aes(y=hyp_d13C, x=pro_d13C))+
  labs(x=expression(delta^{13}*C[Pro]*"(‰)"), y=expression(delta^{13}*C[Hyp]*"(‰)"))+
  scale_x_continuous(position="bottom", limits=c(-24,-7))+
  scale_y_continuous(position = "left",limits=c(-24,-7))+
  geom_point(colour="black", fill= ref_cols[["red algae"]], alpha=0.5, pch=21, size=2)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=hyp_d13C-hyp_d13C_err, ymax=hyp_d13C+hyp_d13C_err), linewidth = 0.2, width=0.2)+
   geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=pro_d13C-pro_d13C_err, xmax=pro_d13C+pro_d13C_err), linewidth = 0.2, width=0.2)+
  geom_abline(intercept=c(0), slope= 1, linetype="solid")+
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
S1B
```

```{r}

  scale_x_continuous(position="bottom", limits=c(5,25))+
  scale_y_continuous(position = "left",limits=c(5,25))+
```

Save Supplementary Figure 1

```{r}
FigS1 <- ggarrange(S1A, S1B, S1C, S1D,
                    labels = c("A", "B","C", "D"),
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 2, widths = c(2, 2), legend="none")
FigS1
ggsave(here('figures','SupplementaryFig1.svg'), width = 17.8, height = 17.8, dpi = 300, units = "cm", device='svg')
ggsave(here('figures','SupplementaryFig1.pdf'), width = 17.8, height = 17.8, dpi = 300, units = "cm", device = cairo_pdf)
```

Correlation coefficients for the QC panels above.

```{r}
QC1corr <- cor(Data$pro_d13C, Data$hyp_d13C, method = 'pearson')
QC2corr <- cor(Data$pro_d15N, Data$hyp_d15N, method = 'pearson')
QC3corr <- cor(Data$d13C_est, Data$d13C, method = 'pearson')
QC4corr <- cor(Data$d15N_est, Data$d15N, method = 'pearson')
QC1corr
QC2corr
QC3corr
QC4corr
```

#4. Supplementary Figure 2 - PCA on amino acid values

Site and faunal-category colours come from script/colors.R (source()'d above):
`combined_cols` / `combined_order` cover both fauna categories and human sites,
since both appear together in these PCA panels (fauna coloured by category,
humans filled by Site).

##4a. PCA on all samples and 10 amino acids, normalised to row mean

```{r}
Sam_N <- Data %>%  select(Site, Sample_ID,category, group, ala_d15N, ser_d15N, asp_d15N, glu_d15N, gly_d15N, thr_d15N, leu_d15N, lys_d15N, val_d15N, phe_d15N)#drop d15N_Ile as missing values
Sam_N  <- na.omit(Sam_N)
Sam_N  <- Sam_N  %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(row_mean = mean(c(ala_d15N, asp_d15N, glu_d15N, ser_d15N, gly_d15N, thr_d15N, leu_d15N, lys_d15N, val_d15N, phe_d15N)))#
Sam_N  <- Sam_N  %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(across(c(ala_d15N, asp_d15N, glu_d15N, ser_d15N, gly_d15N, thr_d15N, leu_d15N, lys_d15N, val_d15N, phe_d15N), ~ .x - row_mean))
```

```{r}
Sam_C <- Data %>%  select(Site, Sample_ID, category, group, ala_d13C, asp_d13C, ser_d13C, glu_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C)#drop d15N_Ile as missing values
Sam_C <- na.omit(Sam_C)
Sam_C  <- Sam_C  %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(row_mean = mean(c(ala_d13C, asp_d13C, ser_d13C, glu_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C)))#
Sam_C  <- Sam_C  %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(across(c(ala_d13C, asp_d13C, glu_d13C, ser_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C), ~ .x - row_mean))
```

Carbon

```{r}
PCA_C <- Sam_C %>%  select(ala_d13C, asp_d13C, glu_d13C, ser_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C)
PCA <- prcomp(PCA_C, scale. = TRUE)

percent_variance_explained <- PCA$sdev^2 / sum(PCA$sdev^2) * 100
pc1_label <- paste0("PC 1 (", round(percent_variance_explained[1], 2), "%)")
pc2_label <- paste0("PC 2 (", round(percent_variance_explained[2], 2), "%)")

PCAvalues_C <- data.frame(Site = Sam_C$Site, group = Sam_C$group, category = Sam_C$category, PCA$x)
humans <-filter(PCAvalues_C, group == "Human")
fauna <-filter(PCAvalues_C, group == "Fauna")

PCAloadings <- data.frame(Variables = rownames(PCA$rotation), PCA$rotation)

S2C <- ggplot ()+
  geom_point(data=fauna, aes(y=PC1, x=PC2, colour=category), pch=23, size=4)+
    geom_point(data=humans, aes(y=PC1, x=PC2, fill=Site), alpha=0.8, colour="black", pch=21, size=3.5)+
  geom_segment(data = PCAloadings, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = (PC1*7),
     yend = (PC2*7)), arrow = arrow(length = unit(1/2, "picas")),
     color = "black") +
  annotate ("text", x = (PCAloadings$PC1*8), y = (PCAloadings$PC2*8),
     label = PCAloadings$Variables,size=3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=combined_cols, breaks=combined_order)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=combined_cols, breaks=combined_order)+
  guides(colour = "none")+  # keep only the Site (fill) legend - avoids the combined legend overflowing the figure width
  xlim(6,-6)+
 ylim(6,-6)+
  labs(title = "", x = pc1_label, y = pc2_label) +
  theme_bw () +
  coord_fixed (ratio = 1)
S2C
```

##4b. PCA on all samples and 10 amino acids, without normalisation

```{r}
Sam_Nx <- Data %>%  select(Site, Sample_ID,category, group, ala_d15N, ser_d15N, asp_d15N, glu_d15N, gly_d15N, thr_d15N, leu_d15N, lys_d15N, val_d15N, phe_d15N)#drop d15N_Ile as missing values
Sam_Nx  <- na.omit(Sam_Nx)
Sam_Cx <- Data %>%  select(Site, Sample_ID, category, group, ala_d13C, asp_d13C, ser_d13C, glu_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C)#drop d15N_Ile as missing values
Sam_Cx <- na.omit(Sam_Cx)
```

Carbon

```{r}
PCA_Cx<- Sam_Cx %>%  select(ala_d13C, asp_d13C, glu_d13C, ser_d13C, gly_d13C, ile_d13C, thr_d13C, leu_d13C, lys_d13C, val_d13C, phe_d13C)

percent_variance_explained <- PCAx$sdev^2 / sum(PCAx$sdev^2) * 100

pc2_label <- paste0("PC 2 (", round(percent_variance_explained[2], 2), "%)")

PCAvalues_Cx <- data.frame(Site = Sam_C$Site, group = Sam_Cx$group, category = Sam_Cx$category, PCAx$x)
humansx <-filter(PCAvalues_Cx, group == "Human")
faunax <-filter(PCAvalues_Cx, group == "Fauna")

PCAloadingsx <- data.frame(Variables = rownames(PCAx$rotation), PCAx$rotation)

S2A <- ggplot ()+

  guides(colour = "none")+  # keep only the Site (fill) legend - avoids the combined legend overflowing the figure width
  xlim(6,-6)+
 ylim(6,-6)+
  labs(title = "", x = pc1_label, y = pc2_label) +
  theme_bw () +
  coord_fixed (ratio = 1)
S2A
```
